reviewer: sf2_semantics_review agent (static comparison against sealed SF7/SF6/SF2)
scope: Static line-by-line comparison of SF8 CONTROLLER/PREFLIGHT/BUILD/LAUNCH/REPORTER against the sealed SF7 CONTROLLER.py.
findings: SF8 CONTROLLER.py is derived from the sealed SF7 CONTROLLER.py with exactly one class of change: lambda_margin is now looked up per arm from LAMBDA_BY_ARM={'control':0.0,'low':0.25,'medium':0.50} instead of SF7's fixed 1.0, and the hinge term is skipped entirely (not computed) when lam==0.0, making control byte-semantically identical to SF6/SF7 control. M remains hardcoded at 1.0. margin_gap()/margin_hinge_term() are unchanged from SF7 (same first-answer-token position, same full-vocabulary log-softmax, same symmetric formula, same integration point after CE+KL). No other scientific line differs: TRAIN16/SCHEDULE.json/KL pool/lambda/positions/binding mechanics/LR/LAM/optimizer/clip/scope/evaluation/gates are byte-identical call sites to SF7/SF6/SF2. gates() does not reference margin anywhere. Transfer/HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING panels are not referenced anywhere in the new source. SF7's directory was not modified; only its already-sealed manifest/frozen files were read to copy byte-identical inputs.
limitations: N=3 same-seed triplets per dose is suggestive only; a single favorable run at a dose is not proof of reliability. This is a narrow dose question, not a new mechanism search.
root_addendum: Confirmed the dose classification labels (LOW_DOSE_FAVORED/MEDIUM_DOSE_FAVORED/BOTH_DOSES_SUPPORTED/CONTROL_FAVORED/MIXED/NO_CLEAR_DIFFERENCE/INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP/TREATMENT_FAILED_RETENTION) are defined in PROTOCOL.json before any run, with INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP and TREATMENT_FAILED_RETENTION taking priority over favorable acquisition counts. All nine runs and both dose levels (0.25, 0.50) were fixed before this review; no dose will be chosen after seeing another dose's results.
